symptom: When source policy v3 (#897) deployed to Alpha, the new control plane's first refresh scan, one second after boot, queued Computer v11 as v3. The old replica was still draining; it claimed the build and failed it as cloud_source_review_required, because its code accepted only policy 2. That also paused the organization's runtime refreshes for six hours.
rule: During a rolling deploy, any replica can claim work that a new replica queues, so that work must be runnable by the old code or wait out the overlap. A newly started builder waits one scan interval before its first automatic refresh. A value that old code rejects ships in a release before anything produces it.
